name: The First Spring in Everwinter
source:
For a long time, the lands of Everwinter remained inaccessible: white snow, cold winds, and frozen waters kept this place hidden from curious eyes for many centuries – until the spring thaw finally arrived. The eternal winter that concealed these lands suddenly receded, revealing uncharted territories to travelers and ordinary wanderers alike.

Now, as the icy mountains have given way to dense green forests, adventurers from all corners of the kingdom are heading north in search of riches, dangers, and new discoveries.

And among these adventurers is Nell of Crownfosse.

[From [url=https://by-vishnevskaya.itch.io/the-first-spring-in-everwinter]Itch.Io[/url]]
translation:
很长一段时间以来，永冬的土地一直难以进入：白雪、寒风和冰冻的海水使这个地方在几个世纪以来一直隐藏在好奇的目光之外——直到春天解冻终于到来。掩盖这些土地的永恒冬天突然退去，向旅行者和普通流浪者展示了未知的领域。

现在，随着冰冷的山脉被茂密的绿色森林所取代，来自王国各个角落的冒险家正在向北前进，寻找财富、危险和新发现。

这些冒险家中就有克朗福斯的内尔。

[来自[url=https://by-vishnevskaya.itch.io/the-first-spring-in-everwinter]Itch.Io[/url]]
